goddessOfTheHarvest.name: Goddess of the Harvest
goddessOfTheHarvest.flavor: She counts the sheaves before the reapers do.
goddessOfTheHarvest.text: Bonus resources that give food gain +1 food.

keeperOfTheHearth.name: Keeper of the Hearth
keeperOfTheHearth.flavor: A fire that has never gone out is worth more than a wall.

starReaders.name: Star Readers
starReaders.flavor: From the high rock the year is a wheel you can see the spokes of.
starReaders.text: +4 science in every town with a mountain in its borders.

keeperOfTheCalendar.name: Keeper of the Calendar
keeperOfTheCalendar.flavor: Nothing is lost that was written down on the right day.

theStandingStones.name: The Standing Stones
theStandingStones.flavor: They were raised by people who expected to be remembered, and were.

ancestorWorship.name: Ancestor Worship
ancestorWorship.flavor: The dead outnumber us, and they vote.
ancestorWorship.text: +1 culture for every 4 citizens in a town.

ladyOfTheHunt.name: Lady of the Hunt
ladyOfTheHunt.flavor: She takes the first kill and leaves the rest, which is why there is a rest.

spiritsOfTheWood.name: Spirits of the Wood
spiritsOfTheWood.flavor: Ask before the axe; the asking is the whole of the rite.
spiritsOfTheWood.text: Unimproved forest and jungle hexes gain +1 faith and +1 culture.

riverMother.name: River Mother
riverMother.flavor: She is not kind. She is regular, which is better.
riverMother.text: Towns on fresh water gain +2 food.

lordOfTheSea.name: Lord of the Sea
lordOfTheSea.flavor: He keeps the count of every net, and forgives none of it.
lordOfTheSea.text: +1 production and +1 gold on every hex with a Fishing Boat.

godOfTheForge.name: God of the Forge
godOfTheForge.flavor: He was lamed by his own work and never once stopped.

ritesOfBlood.name: Rites of Blood
ritesOfBlood.flavor: The altar is old. The queue in front of it is older.
ritesOfBlood.text: Killing a unit grants faith equal to its strength.

oracleOfTheCrossroads.name: Oracle of the Crossroads
oracleOfTheCrossroads.flavor: Every road is a question. She charges for the answer.
oracleOfTheCrossroads.text: Scouts and settlers gain +1 movement and +1 sight.

sacredFire.name: Sacred Fire
sacredFire.flavor: No story, no festival, no priest. It simply must not go out.

desertFathers.name: Desert Fathers
desertFathers.flavor: They went out to find nothing, and were the first to succeed.
desertFathers.text: Desert hexes gain +1 food and +1 faith.

winterMother.name: Winter Mother
winterMother.flavor: She does not sleep through it. She is it.
winterMother.text: +1 food and +1 faith on every tundra hex.

lordOfTheHoard.name: The Stone Hoard
lordOfTheHoard.flavor: Everything the rock gave up is counted, and none of it has ever been spent.
lordOfTheHoard.text: Mines and quarries on a resource gain +1 culture and +1 faith.

courtAugurs.name: The Vigil
courtAugurs.flavor: Somebody sits up with the lamp while the rite is running.
courtAugurs.text: A town keeping a rite gains +15% science and culture.

theLivingRock.name: The Living Rock
theLivingRock.flavor: Cut deep enough and the seam sings back at you.
theLivingRock.text: +1 culture on every hex with a Mine carrying a resource.
theLivingRock.note: Withdrawn: this pantheon is no longer offered. A religion that already keeps it keeps it.

vineyardRites.name: Vineyard Rites
vineyardRites.flavor: The first cup is poured on the ground, and nobody has ever thought it wasted.
vineyardRites.text: +1 food and +1 culture on every hex with a Plantation.

cultOfHeroes.name: Cult of Heroes
cultOfHeroes.flavor: They were people once. The songs have had a long time to work on that.

herdGods.name: Herd Gods
herdGods.flavor: They are counted every evening, and the counting is the prayer.
herdGods.text: +1 production and +1 faith on every hex with a Pasture.

patronOfMerchants.name: Patron of Merchants
patronOfMerchants.flavor: He keeps no temple, only a pair of scales at every crossroads.
patronOfMerchants.text: +1 faith and +2 gold for each different luxury you hold.

theMuses.name: The Muses
theMuses.flavor: Nine sisters, and each of them expects to be thanked by name.
theMuses.text: +1 faith for every 3 culture you make each turn.

cathedralsOfTheSky.name: Cathedrals of the Sky
cathedralsOfTheSky.flavor: They built the roof first and reasoned downwards.

pilgrimage.name: Pilgrimage
pilgrimage.flavor: The road there is the offering; the shrine is only where it stops.
pilgrimage.text: A town that follows gains +1 faith for every 3 followers.

feastDays.name: Feast Days
feastDays.flavor: Nobody argues with a calendar that promises dinner.
feastDays.text: +1 happiness for every city that follows, and Temples supply +1 happiness.

holyWater.name: Holy Water
holyWater.flavor: Any water will do, once somebody has said the words over it.
holyWater.text: Towns that follow and stand on fresh water gain +10% food.

lampsOfTheShrine.name: Lamps of the Shrine
lampsOfTheShrine.flavor: Oil is cheap. Being awake at that hour is not.
lampsOfTheShrine.text: Shrines in towns that follow give +2 science.

choirs.name: Choirs
choirs.flavor: Forty people, one breath, and the roof holds it a moment longer.
choirs.text: +1 culture for every 4 citizens of a city that follows.

titheHouses.name: Tithe Houses
titheHouses.flavor: A tenth of everything, counted by people who can count.
titheHouses.text: +1 gold for every 3 citizens of a city that follows.

theQuietHours.name: The Quiet Hours
theQuietHours.flavor: Nothing is asked of you between the bells. That is the whole of it.
theQuietHours.text: In towns that follow, each building that supplies faith gives +2 culture and +1 happiness.

warriorMonks.name: Warrior Monks
warriorMonks.flavor: They keep the fast, and they keep the gate.
warriorMonks.text: +10 combat strength for units defending a city that follows.

harvestBlessing.name: Harvest Blessing
harvestBlessing.flavor: The field was going to do that anyway. Say the words.
harvestBlessing.text: +1 food on every farm worked by a city that follows.

guildOfTheFaithful.name: Guild of the Faithful
guildOfTheFaithful.flavor: Piety and scaffolding, in that order, on the same books.
guildOfTheFaithful.text: +15% production toward buildings in every town that follows.

commonTable.name: Common Table
commonTable.flavor: Everyone eats, and what is left is put by for everyone.
commonTable.text: A city that follows keeps a quarter of its stored food when it grows.

minarets.name: Minarets
minarets.flavor: You can hear it from the edge of the fields, which is the point.
minarets.text: Unlocks the Mosque: +3 faith, +2 production and +1 authority.

templeSpires.name: Temple Spires
templeSpires.flavor: Gold leaf, and underneath it a great deal of ordinary teak.
templeSpires.text: Unlocks the Wat: +3 happiness, and +1 faith for every 2 citizens.

theOpenKitchen.name: The Open Kitchen
theOpenKitchen.flavor: Nobody is asked who they are before they are handed a plate.
theOpenKitchen.text: Unlocks the Gurdwara: +3 food, +3 faith, and +1 science for every 3 citizens.

theEternalFlame.name: The Eternal Flame
theEternalFlame.flavor: Somebody has been awake with it every night for four hundred years.
theEternalFlame.text: Unlocks the Dar-e Mehr: +25% faith in its town.

theAlmsBox.name: The Alms Box
theAlmsBox.flavor: The box by the door is never locked, and it is never empty for long.
theAlmsBox.text: Towns that follow buy with faith for 20% less.

reliquaries.name: Reliquaries
reliquaries.flavor: A bone in a box, and a queue around the block.
reliquaries.text: +1 culture for every 3 faith you make each turn.

inquisition.name: Inquisition
inquisition.flavor: Doubt is welcome. Bring it here, where we can look at it.
inquisition.text: Rival religions press your towns with a Temple at half strength.

theLongRoad.name: The Long Road
theLongRoad.flavor: Every cart that leaves carries two things, and only one is grain.
theLongRoad.text: Your religion presses 2 harder along roads and trade routes.

itinerantPreachers.name: Itinerant Preachers
itinerantPreachers.flavor: No roof, no stipend, and an alarming amount of walking.
itinerantPreachers.text: Towns that follow press your religion 5 hexes further.

thePulseOfBells.name: The Pulse of Bells
thePulseOfBells.flavor: They rang for an hour. People remember where they were standing.
thePulseOfBells.text: A proclamation reaches 4 hexes further and presses 20 faith harder.

ecclesia.name: Ecclesia
ecclesia.flavor: The stones were here first. We only agreed about them.
ecclesia.text: Each holy site gives +1 faith for each town in the world that follows your religion.

apostles.name: Apostles
apostles.flavor: Twelve of them, and none with a fixed address.

sacredCartography.name: Sacred Cartography
sacredCartography.flavor: The map is drawn from both ends and meets in the middle.
sacredCartography.text: Your trade routes press your religion at both ends.

holyOrder.name: Holy Order
holyOrder.flavor: They took vows. One of them was about the sword.
holyOrder.text: Unlocks Knights Templar, bought with faith. They gain +6 strength in land that follows your religion.

theocraticMandate.name: Theocratic Mandate
theocraticMandate.flavor: The throne is a chair the god is not currently using.
theocraticMandate.text: Rulers who share your faith owe you for it.
deferred: a claim on empires that follow you
theocraticMandate.note: Withdrawn: this belief is no longer offered. It never had an effect, because the game has no diplomacy for it to act on.

congregation.name: Congregation
congregation.flavor: A crowd that knows the words is a crowd that stays.
congregation.text: +2 faith for every town in the world that follows your religion.

pilgrimsCoin.name: Pilgrims' Coin
pilgrimsCoin.flavor: They arrive with nothing and leave having spent it.
pilgrimsCoin.text: +4 gold for every city in the world that follows.

worldChurch.name: World Church
worldChurch.flavor: Two kings, one calendar, and a long argument about the date.
worldChurch.text: +15% culture for every empire in the world that follows you.

theLongPrayer.name: The Long Prayer
theLongPrayer.flavor: It began at dawn. Nobody has been brave enough to end it.
theLongPrayer.text: +1 culture for every 4 citizens in the world who follow you.

theCrusade.name: The Crusade
theCrusade.flavor: They took the long road, and every town along it fed them.
theCrusade.text: Your units gain +6 strength in foreign land that follows your religion.

thePromisedLand.name: The Promised Land
thePromisedLand.flavor: It was described to them before any of them had seen it.
thePromisedLand.text: Settlers you send out carry an extra citizen: the cities they found start one larger.
thePromisedLand.note: Withdrawn: this belief is no longer offered. A religion that already keeps it keeps it.

marvelsOfTheFaith.name: Marvels of the Faith
marvelsOfTheFaith.flavor: Every one of them was raised by somebody who had heard of the last one.
marvelsOfTheFaith.text: +5 science and +5 culture for every city in the world that follows you and holds a wonder.

theScriptoria.name: The Scriptoria
theScriptoria.flavor: A thousand hands copying, and only two of them ever asked what it said.
theScriptoria.text: +1 science for every faith building in a city that follows you.

riteOfTheHarvest.name: Rite of the Harvest
riteOfTheHarvest.flavor: The grain was always going to come up. Somebody has to be thanked.
riteOfTheHarvest.text: Hexes that give food give +1 more.

omenReading.name: Omen Reading
omenReading.flavor: The liver said what the scribe already suspected.
omenReading.text: +1 science for each building in this town.

consecrationOfTheBounds.name: Consecration of the Bounds
consecrationOfTheBounds.flavor: Walk the line once a year and the line walks itself the rest of it.
consecrationOfTheBounds.text: Luxury hexes gain +1 culture, and this town's borders grow 30% faster.

blessingOfArms.name: Blessing of Arms
blessingOfArms.flavor: The god does not promise you live. Only that it will be worth watching.
blessingOfArms.note: The rite holds the walls and nothing else: a soldier standing inside them mends at the ordinary pace.

riteOfPlenty.name: Rite of Plenty
riteOfPlenty.flavor: A feast is an argument that the year was good, made loudly enough to win.
riteOfPlenty.text: Hexes with a resource give +1 gold.

thePreaching.name: The Preaching
thePreaching.flavor: He spoke for two hours. Four people stayed, and they told everyone.
thePreaching.note: Withdrawn. A prophet makes this noise now, and makes it louder.

recastingTheOmens.name: Recasting the Omens
recastingTheOmens.flavor: The bones fell badly. They were gathered up, and they fell again.
recastingTheOmens.note: Withdrawn. A hand of gods may be asked again for faith instead.

riteOfFasting.name: Rite of Fasting
riteOfFasting.flavor: The table is set and left bare, and the faithful count what they did not eat.
riteOfFasting.text: This town does not grow, and gains +1 science and +1 culture for each citizen.
riteOfFasting.note: Opened by the Order The Fast. The town stores no food toward growth while it fasts; food already stored stays where it is.

votiveOffering.name: Votive Offering
votiveOffering.flavor: A candle, a coin and a name, left at the foot of the scaffold.
votiveOffering.text: Spend faith to add that much production to what this town is building. Not wonders.
votiveOffering.note: Opened while the Order The Votive Gifts is seated. The town keeps it until the next turn, so each city may offer it once a turn.

restoringOfTheHost.name: Restoring of the Host
restoringOfTheHost.flavor: They came in carried and went out marching.
restoringOfTheHost.text: Heals every unit of yours in land that follows your religion.
restoringOfTheHost.note: Opened while the Order The Host Restored is seated. The town keeps it for a while before it may say it again.

riteOfTheSabbath.name: Rite of the Sabbath
riteOfTheSabbath.flavor: The forges are cold, the market is shut, and the whole town has gone to hear the choir.
riteOfTheSabbath.text: This town builds nothing, and gains its production as culture.
riteOfTheSabbath.note: Opened by the Order The Sabbath Laws. Production the town buys, or is given at once, still goes into what it is building. A town in unrest makes no production, so it has none to give.

scholarsCrypt.name: The Scholars' Crypt
scholarsCrypt.flavor: They buried the librarians under the floor so nobody would move the books.
scholarsCrypt.text: +1 science for every 2 followers in this city.

choirLoft.name: The Choir Loft
choirLoft.flavor: Forty voices, one of them slightly wrong, for four hundred years.
choirLoft.text: +1 culture for every 2 followers in this city.

treasuryOfRelics.name: The Treasury of Relics
treasuryOfRelics.flavor: A finger bone, a nail, a scrap of sail. Pilgrims pay to stand near them.
treasuryOfRelics.text: +3 gold for every faith building in this city.

masonsChapel.name: The Masons' Chapel
masonsChapel.flavor: The lodge kept its own altar, and its own idea of who the saints were.
masonsChapel.text: +10% production toward wonders in this city.

eternalFlame.name: The Eternal Flame
eternalFlame.flavor: It has gone out twice. Both times somebody relit it before morning.
eternalFlame.text: +1 faith for every follower in this city.

theGreenCathedral.name: The Green Cathedral
theGreenCathedral.flavor: The nave was left roofless on purpose, and the wood grew in.
theGreenCathedral.text: +1 faith and +1 culture on every unimproved hex this city works.
theGreenCathedral.note: Withdrawn: a cathedral is no longer dedicated to this patron. A town whose cathedral already has it keeps it.
